defs: adj	Returning quickly to normal after damaging events or conditions. (of systems, organisms or people)
adj	(psychology, neuroscience) Having the ability to recover from mental illness, trauma, etc.; having resilience.
adj	Returning quickly to original shape after force is applied; elastic. (of objects or substances)
adj	(materials science) Having the ability to absorb energy when deformed.
